name: @catheadowl/dsh-eval
description: Agent eval framework over dsh headless runs: case runner, session-trace assertions, and a scripted mock-LLM layer for plugin intent tests.

scripts.prepack: node scripts/verify-manifest-face.mjs && node scripts/verify-publish-readiness.mjs && node scripts/verify-readme-i18n.mjs && node scripts/verify-experimental-face.mjs
scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/trace.test.mjs tests/assertions.test.mjs tests/overlay.test.mjs tests/staging.test.mjs tests/runner.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/discovery.test.mjs tests/review.test.mjs tests/report.test.mjs tests/config.test.mjs tests/review-report.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-publish-readiness.mjs && node scripts/verify-manifest-face.mjs && node scripts/verify-readme-i18n.mjs && node scripts/verify-experimental-face.mjs
